message: Here are 4 construction hazards I identified from the image

hazards.title: Unprotected floor opening
hazards.description: A large rectangular floor opening in the lower right foreground has no cover, guardrail, or barricade around it, exposing workers walking through the area to a fall into the pit.
hazards.category: Working at Heights and Fall Protection

hazards.title: Work inside open switchgear
hazards.description: A worker at left is working directly inside open electrical switchgear with exposed wiring and components, with no visible lockout/tagout devices on the equipment.

hazards.title: Extension cord across walkway
hazards.description: A yellow extension cord runs loosely across the open floor from the switchgear area at left to the floor opening at lower right, creating a trip hazard in the walkway.

hazards.title: Materials staged in work area
hazards.description: Palletized materials beside the stepladder and cable tray sections on pallets near the workbench are staged on the open floor, narrowing walkways and adding obstruction hazards.
